plans.goal: block the road and keep Maud safe behind the cart
steps: form a wall between the road and Maud
use the cart as cover and rally point
if anyone breaks through, drag them back or shove them into the water

atoms.text: I'm moving to block the road between Col and Maud—no one gets past me
Borin, stand behind the cart with Maud—guard her if anything comes from the side
I'll ready my guard—if Col charges at Maud, I shove him into the water
Pip and Wren, on the archer Nell—don't let her shoot us up from the north
Borin, move left past the cart—Fitch will try to flank from the trees
Knock down the bees' nest—anything in range gets stung, and we can slip through

plans.goal: pressure Col while Borin holds the center line
steps: use the handcart as cover and a choke point
push forward with Borin to keep Col pinned near the torch
if they try to spread out, collapse the line to stay together

atoms.text: Borin and I move up to the cart—we hold this line and don't let them past
Col won't leave the road—Pip, circle left and get him cornered with us
Nell's up north—if she has a clear shot, I duck behind the cart and ready my shield
Maud, stay back and heal anyone who takes a beating—I'll drag them to you if needed
If Fitch gets close, I shove him into the barrel—he's slow and exposed

plans.goal: use the terrain to split and defeat them one at a time
steps: set the stacked logs rolling to scatter their formation
funnel them through the water and brush where Pip can outmaneuver them
keep Maud safely north of the trees where she can see and heal

atoms.text: Cut the log-pile loose—it rolls west and smashes whoever is in the way
Borin, hold the center after the logs hit—keep them from regrouping
Pip moves through the trees while they're scattered—pin Nell against the north ridge
Maud, hold north behind the trees—if anyone comes for you, we pull back and regroup
Once they're split, everyone hits whoever is closest—Borin and I follow up on each one
